description: The graph generator Upptime runs with npx, installed by Graphs CI before the action so npx uses this copy. canvas 3 instead of the canvas 2 that @upptime/graphs asks for: canvas 2 has no binaries past Node 20, and when built from source on Node 22+ every graph comes out black. @octokit/rest 20 (the last CommonJS line, same Octokit and repos.listCommits) instead of 18: 18 pulls @octokit/request, request-error and plugin-paginate-rest versions with ReDoS advisories.
